resources.string: When your car connects: hear who\'s calling, answer favourites, reply that you\'re driving
car, driving, drive, bluetooth, android auto, announce, say caller name, hands-free, handsfree, auto answer, silence unknown, driving reply

Mark your car\'s Bluetooth. While it\'s connected, Parley can say who\'s calling, answer favourites for you and offer replies like \"I\'m driving\". It turns off when the car disconnects. No location is used.
No Bluetooth devices yet. Pair your car in Android\'s Bluetooth settings, or connect to it and come back.
Allow \"Nearby devices\" so Parley can list them. Only their names are read.
Other devices may also be called \"%1$s\". Allow \"Nearby devices\" so Parley knows your car by its address, not only its name.
Once, through the car, for your contacts. Not while the phone is on silent or Do Not Disturb.
Chosen on their page or their label\'s page
With a countdown and Cancel on the call screen. Never during another call.
Numbers that aren\'t saved ring silently and show as missed calls. Emergency call-backs always ring.
When you reply to a call with a message, driving replies come first.
